sql.customer.getAllByCompany: select id, first_name, last_name, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, email, phone, company_id from flow.customer where company_id = :companyId;
sql.customer.getById: select id, first_name, last_name, date_created, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, email, phone, mobile, company_id, street1, city, 44 as state_id from flow.customer where id = :customerId
sql.customer.insertCustomer: insert into flow.customer(customer_type_id, first_name, last_name, street1, city, state_id, postal_code, country_id, phone, email, mobile, created_by_id, company_id) values (:customerTypeId, :firstName, :lastName, :city, :stateId, :postalCode, :countryId, :phone, :email, :mobile, :createdById, :companyId)
